description: Discover a hub's registered intents, language examples and fallback skills using its runtime identity. Unknown fallback support remains distinct from a known empty list; answerability is a conservative hint.

configPath.description: Path to a Thalovant SDK config file.

fallback.description: Try engine manifests if the intent listing is refused or unanswered.

fromEnv.description: Load the identity from Thalovant SDK environment variables.

identityFile.description: Path to a Thalovant identity JSON file.

sentence.description: Capitalize and punctuate examples using the selected locale. Implies speakable rendering.

slots.description: Example values for named intent slots.

speakable.description: Render intent patterns with locale slot examples; preserve complete-phrase priority.

timeoutMs.description: Per-query/batch timeout; the optional fallback-skill probe is capped at 1500ms.

name: thalovant_intent_inventory
title: Runtime Intent Inventory
